meta.name: update-project-docs
meta.description: Keep this repository's documentation in sync after any change to behavior, configuration, interfaces, events, schema, or features. Use when the user asks to "update the docs / README / wiki / architecture", AND proactively (without being asked) at the end of any change-set that adds or alters an env var, event type, hook behavior, session/agent state transition, API route or response shape, DB schema, WebSocket message, MCP tool, CLI command, or user-facing feature. Knows the full doc surface (README + VN/CN, ARCHITECTURE, root index.html, wiki + i18n, server/client READMEs, docs/*) and which docs each kind of change touches.
